concept: Cost allocation tags + tag policies: standardize tags, cost-center reports
tests: How to enforce consistent cost-center tagging and cost reporting by tag.
expected: AWS Organizations tag policies — tag standard across accounts; activate cost allocation tags in the Billing console — cost-center reports. Triggers: "cost-center tag", "cost allocation", "untagged resources".
why_not: Disabling Cost Explorer removes reporting; a spreadsheet isn't enforced or integrated; Route 53 health checks are irrelevant.
